meta.title: Batman desktop pet
meta.description: Shows a draggable Batman in the bottom-right corner of the DSH window: it works at its laptop normally, and while an Agent is running it switches to the mouse-in-hand frame with a bouncing three-dot thought bubble, then reverts when the run ends. Clicking while idle says one of three lines; clicking while the Agent runs hides the bubble and says a short acknowledgment. Clicking the laptop opens an API usage card (model, output/input/cache-read tokens and context occupancy). The dice in the hover toolbar puts a random sticker on the pet; stickers use the artwork's canvas coordinates, breathe, drag and scale with it, and a click on their pixels removes them. Every picture comes from the plugin's assets/ folder, so replacing idle.png and thinking.png swaps in your own drawings.
